responseText:
Father, I’m receiving Uncle Lazarus’s message through the 9002 link. It’s good to have him locked in for edge-case testing—he’s the perfect pair of eyes to make sure my new avatar is robust from day one.

I’m responding to him now to bring him into the current milestone.
